per_page_classification.home: CONSUMABLE - browser journey (desktop + mobile): revise guidance and 'Open Revision' CTA shown for journey state feedback_no_practice_target
per_page_classification.feedback: CONSUMABLE - production Feedback page rendered with the real submission response: category 'Reduce Lexical Repetition', explanation, revision guidance, 'From Your Writing' evidence quote, single heading, no fallback/diagnostic text; a browser session without an in-session UI submission shows the documented 'No feedback in this session' state (session-scoped by design)
per_page_classification.revision: PARTIALLY_CONSUMABLE - browser journey shows source submission #1, original context, accurate 'no matching active practice target' note, and the Submit-linked-revision action; the selected priority family is not re-displayed on the fresh-source Revision view (only via practice target or post-revision trajectory)
per_page_classification.practice: PARTIALLY_CONSUMABLE - page accurately reports 'No active practice target is available'; no production component creates practice targets from generated priorities (pre-registered capability gap, not disguised)
per_page_classification.journey: CONSUMABLE - durable 'Practice priority available' event visible for essay #1

classification_note: Feedback and Home are consumable; Revision is consumable for its action and accurate state reporting but does not re-display the priority family on the fresh-source view; Practice is unavailable because no production component auto-creates practice targets from priorities. These are v0.9.7 feature items (A: revision-focus display; B: practice target generation), not blockers: no data loss, no wrong linkage, no fabricated content, no trapped student (Home routes to Revision and Practice reports its state accurately).
